minimumBridge.proposedOwner: work-engine-server job application (job outcome consumer), not Pi execution/acknowledgement owner and not workspace Git owner
minimumBridge.proposedTransition: A new typed settle_coding_job_completion operation (proposed name, no existing implementation claimed) persists one exact job-level completion binding after independently reading accepted checkpoint and settled publication through trusted owner APIs. read_coding_job_result then exposes this checked job outcome alongside the immutable component receipt.

minimumBridge.persistence: Reuse the job operation ownership and existing durable identity/CAS patterns; exact schema/record placement is a proposed seam requiring contract acceptance, not a request to add a second publication ledger. An implementation must cold-reopen and re-read owner-backed references, not trust saved JSON alone.
minimumBridge.terminalMeaning: Keep historical component receipt acceptance=owner_pending immutable. NEW job-level accepted/published outcome may be established only by an explicitly authorized consuming contract. W0 itself remains publication-only.

existingVersusMissing: Existing W0 campaign/workspace settlement is callable after custody/startup work. The inspected production coding-job result route has no join to it. This is an additional owner-level consumer/acceptance contract and bridge; changing read_result to copy a verdict or clearing Pi owner_pending would be invalid. No repository-wide absence claim.
proofNeeded: one new original job -> exact export/checkpoint -> real review -> authenticated task/checkpoint acceptance -> exact offer/create -> production publication -> job-level settlement
